reason: The plugin monitors configured LLM provider balances by resolving host-side credentials, querying supported balance APIs, and displaying results beneath the chat input with recharge links.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框下显示已配置大模型提供商的账户余额，并支持刷新余额和打开充值页面。
summaries.en: Displays balances for configured LLM providers beneath the chat input, with refresh controls and links to provider recharge pages.

capabilities: Reads configured LLM provider credentials through the host credential system
Serves balance data through a web route
Displays provider balances beneath the chat input
Opens provider recharge pages in a new browser tab
